verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar akaar kar eka(n)kaar apaar sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: On assuming form that formless Lord was called as the boundless Ekankar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar ik kavaau pasaau karaiaa|

en.bdb: Ekankar became Oankar whose one vibration spread as the creation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਤਤ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਕਰਿ ਪੰਜ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੰਜ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j tat paravaan kar pa(n)j mitr pa(n)j satr milaiaa|

en.bdb: Then were created the five elements and five friends (truth, contentment and compassion etc.) and five enemies (the five evil propensities) of the creatures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਸਦਾਇ ਸਾਧੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)je ti(n)n asaadh saadh saadh sadhai saadh biradhaiaa|

en.bdb: Man harnessed the incurable ailments of five evil propensities and three qualities of nature and maintained his virtuous reputation of being a sadhu.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਲਿਖਿ ਅਗੋਂ ਪਿਛੀਂ ਸਹਸ ਫਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)je eka(n)kaar likh ago(n) pichhee(n) sahas falaiaa|

en.bdb: Five Gurus one after the other composed thousands of hymns, bat in praise of Ekankar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜੇ ਅਖਰ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹੁਇ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)je akhar paradhaan kar paramesar hui naau dharaiaa|

en.bdb: The bearer of fivelettered name, Nanak Dev, became prominent like God and was called Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦ ਅੰਗਹੁਂ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur naanak dheau hai gur a(n)gadh a(n)gahu(n) upajaiaa|

en.bdb: These Guru are the true Guru Nanak Dev who created Guru Angad out of his own limbs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗਦ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਮਰਪਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)gadh te gur amarapadh a(n)mirat raam naam gur bhaiaa|

en.bdb: From Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das, the attainer of immortal status of Guru and from him getting the nectar name of the Lord, Guru Ram Das was loved by the people.
From Guru Ram Das, like his shadow emerged Guru Arjan Dev
